name: refpact-workspace
description: Workspace of the TypeScript side of refpact. The Rust side is the Cargo workspace in the same directory.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter refpact build && pnpm --filter refpact test && pnpm --filter fixture-app test && pnpm --filter fixture-app test:node
scripts.api-docs: cargo doc --package refpact --package refpact-core --no-deps && pnpm --filter refpact-api-docs build
